The background shows an urban intersection with modern architecture, green trees, and some traffic including cars and scooters. (2) She moves to a calm outdoor water fountain area surrounded by clean stone ledges. She carefully places the heavy rose basket onto the stone surface and gently adjusts the position of a few individual flowers with her fingers, looking down at them with a focused and serene expression. (3) The woman walks through an elegant architectural corridor featuring large stone arches and luxury storefronts. Several vertical banners with brand names are visible as she walks away from the camera, then turns back to give a wide, bright smile while clutching the flower basket. (4) A close-up shot focuses on her hands as she holds a few delicate pink flower petals over the dense arrangement of roses. Her hands are adorned with several silver rings, and she gently rubs a petal, highlighting the soft texture of the flowers against the bright natural daylight. (5) She is shown crossing a different street section, walking towards the camera with a look of pure joy. She holds the large rose basket close to her body as various vehicles, including a yellow taxi and scooters, pass in the background under the clear sky.
